For the plugin with its three skills, the route is `claude plugin eval`: cases run with the plugin and against a no-plugin baseline, and the delta is what you read. You can scaffold the cases with `claude plugin eval init`, or through `/evals:design`, and run them with `/evals:plugin-eval`.
